major_concerns: Potential training-data contamination of public NetOps examples (inflates baseline).
Deterministic reachability validator may have false negatives; reliance on validator alone could misattribute success.
Emulation realism: mininet/container routers may not capture important device behaviors or side-effects.
Intent ambiguity may dominate residual failures unless intents are tightly specified/normalized.
required_design_repairs: Add provenance/audit procedures to exclude examples likely present in model training data.
Specify the exact validator implementation (e.g., Batfish config) and its known completeness/limits; include tests to measure validator false-negative rate against emulation.
Define emulation topology suite and justify realism; isolate all execution to non-production testbeds and document images/versions.
Preregister intent normalization rules and an ambiguity-resolution policy (e.g., clarifying-question prompt or conservative interpretation).
Provide sample-size power justification for N and formalize the paired test decision rule and retry policy.

major_concerns: Dataset contamination risk (ACL templates may appear in LLM training data).
Sequence-level confidence metrics are underspecified (multiple plausible definitions).
Formal ACL verifier equivalence definition and limitations need explicit statement.
Calibration fold leakage risk if calibration set not strictly held-out.
required_design_repairs: Define exact confidence features to be used (avg log-prob, normalized seq score, token-entropy aggregation) and justify choices.
Implement and document a provenance audit to exclude/flag examples present in public corpora or common config templates.
Specify and validate the formal ACL verifier (equivalence criteria, edge cases) and provide unit tests showing verifier correctness on synthetic cases.
Preregister calibration procedure (fold split, scaling method), and commit to held-out calibration and test sets with random-seed reproducibility.
Provide power/sample calculations supporting M≥500 or increase M if needed and document contamination-exclusion proportion.

major_concerns: Perturbation generator may introduce biased or unrealistic perturbations if not rigorously specified.
Correctness measurement depends on validators/emulation; need clear evaluation oracle.
Risk of overfitting to exemplars (hardened prompts may merely encode dataset heuristics).
Single-model evaluation (if planned) limits external validity.
required_design_repairs: Preregister perturbation rules with algorithmic generators and provide representative examples and seeds; include manual spot-checks to validate realism.
Specify the validator/emulation used for correctness and ensure it is run consistently across strategies.
Include at least one additional model or a sensitivity analysis to check whether robustness gains generalize beyond a single LLM.
Add metrics for both mean accuracy and failure diversity (to detect brittle overfitting) and justify T≥300 with a power analysis.

major_concerns: Design currently proposes an optional human pilot but capability manifest forbids human scientific labour; this must be reconciled.
Simulated reviewer models may not capture real reviewer behavior—results depend heavily on simulation assumptions.
Policy evaluation depends on upstream verifier/discriminator quality and prior-candidate outputs; dependencies must be made explicit and controlled.
Cost/time-per-review assumptions may be organization-specific and change results materially.
required_design_repairs: Remove or reframe any required human-in-the-loop pilot to a simulated-reviewer evaluation (or justify ethically/contractually if real reviewers will be used and ensure permissions).
Preregister the simulated reviewer model (accuracy, bias parameters) and run sensitivity analyses over a range of reviewer accuracies.

Explicitly state dependencies on outputs from other candidates and either (a) produce a held-out, independent task set for this study or (b) describe how prior-output reuse is controlled to avoid double-dipping.

Make the cost model parametric and report Pareto frontiers under a range of review-time assumptions; provide conservative bounds on catastrophic-action estimates given verifier false-negative uncertainty.
